answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents mint stake-backed cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Validating each node demands an exponential capital deposit: solitary nodes thrive like a sparrow in flight, while swarms face quadratic staking escalation that drains attacker resources. An adversary attempting to flood the market like a vast ocean is crushed under superlinear slashing penalties, leaving only genuine, ivory tower grade agents solvent.
